description:
5+ years of demonstrated experience designing, developing and deploying high-volume, multi-tiered, distributed transactional applications 
 3+ years - Expert knowledge of .Net, WCF, WF for .Net 4.5, MVC application frameworks, design patterns, web and application servers. Must be hands-on. 
 3+ years - Experience in systems analysis and design using OOP concepts 
 Experience in data access technologies and patterns 
 Experience with SOA technologies (REST and SOAP) desired 
 Experience in using AJAX and JavaScript libraries (JQuery)  
 Experience working in full iterative/Agile development environment 
 Relational database experience and demonstrated abilities in SQL and data modeling is required 
 Experience with component based web application frameworks is desired 
 Ability to communicate effectively, both written and verbal, with technical and non-technical cross-functional teams 

 Design, development and implementation of complex multi-tier systems with Web front end using .Net / C# technologies. 
 
 Deliver high quality code to realize business requirements, perform peer design and code reviews, and use test driven development practices 
 Create and execute unit, integration and regression test plans/scripts  

 Duration: Full Time 
 
 
 Eligiblity: GC & US Citizens Only 
 
 Share the Profiles to mahesh(at)tammina.com  

 
 Contact: 703-349-1214 
 
 
 Keep the subject line with Job Title and Location
